app.title: Restaurant POS
app.pitch: Sales, stock, recipes, purchasing and central kitchen in one place. On desktop, tablet and phone.

auth.codeHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.enrollHelp: Your role requires an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator). Add this key, then enter the code it shows.
auth.recoveryHelp: Each code works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.

shell.noBusiness: You are not a member of any active business yet.

subscription.expiring: Your subscription ends in {{count}} days. Transfer and message the admin to extend.
subscription.grace: Your subscription has ended. You have a short grace period: please renew.
subscription.read_only: Your subscription has ended. You can view and export, but not make changes.

dashboard.empty: Your figures appear here once daily sales and stock are recorded (Phase 1).

install.title: Install the app
install.body: Open it from your home screen or desktop, in its own window.

errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
errors.invalid_code: That code is not valid. Try the newest code.
errors.session_expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.permission_denied: You do not have permission for this.
errors.module_disabled: This module is switched off for your business.
errors.network_error: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_setting: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.service_charge_not_allowed: Cloud kitchens cannot charge a service charge.
errors.invalid_reference: Something you selected no longer exists. Reload and try again.

errors.category_too_deep: Categories can be nested at most 20 levels.
errors.sku_taken: Another item already uses this SKU.
errors.stale_version: Someone else saved this item first. Reload to see their change.

errors.conversion_to_base_unit: A conversion cannot use the base unit itself.
errors.no_unit_conversion: This unit has no conversion for the item.
errors.channel_code_taken: A channel with this code already exists.
errors.channel_code_locked: A channel code cannot change after it is created.

errors.price_already_started: This price has already started; add a new start date instead.

errors.ingredient_has_no_recipe: Ingredients are bought, so they have no recipe.
errors.component_not_stock_item: Only ingredients and semi-finished items can go into a recipe.

errors.batch_insufficient: That batch does not hold enough.
errors.expiry_required: This item spoils: enter an expiry date.
errors.item_not_stocked: This item is not tracked in stock.
errors.opening_after_movements: This item already has stock movements here; opening stock must come first.
errors.batch_already_used: Part of this stock is already used, so it cannot be undone.
errors.outlet_not_found: This outlet does not exist or is inactive.
errors.wrong_status: This document has already moved on. Reload to see its status.
errors.approver_role_required: Your role cannot approve this; the approval rule names another role.
errors.cannot_approve_own_request: You cannot approve your own request.
errors.count_incomplete: Enter a counted quantity for every line first.
errors.items_required: Choose at least one item to count.
errors.invalid_image: This file is not a supported image. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose light or dark mode, an accent colour and a background.

settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings. Only owners and co-owners can change them.

tax.help: Rates are set per business; check regional rates with your tax advisor.
tax.name: Name
tax.invalidRate: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, at most 2 decimals.

service.cloudKitchen: Cloud kitchens never charge a service charge.

approvals.help: Documents at or above the amount need approval from this role.

stock.help: What happens when more is used than the system shows on hand.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.readOnly: You can view the catalog. Ask a manager to change items or prices.

items.empty: No items yet. Add your first menu item or ingredient.
items.noMatch: No items match. Try another word or type.

problems.sku: SKU: letters, digits and . _ / - only, up to 64.
problems.name: Enter a name in at least one language.
problems.shelfLife: Shelf life is a whole number of days.
problems.conversion: Each conversion needs a different unit and a number above 0.

conversions.title: Unit conversions
conversions.help: For example 1 box = 2500 (base units). Kilograms and grams, litres and millilitres convert automatically.
conversions.factor: Base units in 1 of this unit

prices.title: Prices per channel
prices.help: A price applies from its start date until a newer one starts. Promotions are discounts on the sale, not prices.
prices.noChannels: Add a sales channel first (Catalog, Sales channels).

channels.help: Where you sell: dine-in, takeaway, each delivery app, wholesale. Each can have its own prices.
channels.name: Name

recipe.title: Recipe
recipe.help: What one unit is made of. Saved changes stay a draft until you activate them from a start date; sales and production keep the version they used.
recipe.costUnknown: Cost not known yet: ingredient costs come from purchases and stock, which arrive in a later update.
recipe.margin: Price without tax {{price}} Â· margin {{margin}} Â· HPP {{pct}} %

problems.qty: Each line needs a quantity above 0 and a unit.
problems.yield: Say how much one batch makes.

photo.title: Photo
photo.optional: Optional. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB.
photo.tooBig: This file is larger than 8 MB.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.empty: No stock recorded at this outlet yet.
inventory.negative: Below zero: more was used than was recorded in
inventory.fefo: Used in this order: earliest expiry first.

opening.help: Enter what this outlet holds when it starts. Each item can get an opening stock once; to fix a mistake, undo it and post again.
opening.undone: Undone. The reversal is kept in the history.

docs.adjustHelp: Use adjustments only when no count, waste or delivery explains the change. Larger changes wait for approval.
docs.blind: Blind count (counters do not see the system quantity)
docs.blindHelp: Count what is physically there. The system quantity appears after you submit.
